shiny_inputs.label: Select reads folder
shiny_inputs.title: Select folder containing FASTQ/BAM files
shiny_inputs.help: Folder containing FASTQ or BAM files. BAM files are automatically converted to FASTQ.

shiny_inputs.label: Platform type
shiny_inputs.help: Sequencing platform. Auto-detected from FASTQ header if not specified.

shiny_inputs.label: User
shiny_inputs.help: User name to include in the report

shiny_inputs.label: Output filename
shiny_inputs.help: Name of the output HTML report file

shiny_inputs.label: Run date
shiny_inputs.help: Run date (auto-detected from FASTQ header if not provided)

shiny_inputs.label: Flowcell ID
shiny_inputs.help: Flowcell ID (auto-detected from FASTQ header if not provided)

shiny_inputs.label: Basecaller model
shiny_inputs.help: Basecaller model (auto-detected from FASTQ header if not provided)

shiny_inputs.label: Subsample fraction
shiny_inputs.help: Fraction of reads to subsample (0.01-1.0). Use 1.0 for no subsampling.

shiny_inputs.label: Save raw data
shiny_inputs.help: Save the raw faster/faster2 output files in the output directory
